title: Lead IT System Admin
description:
**Job Posting Title**


Lead IT System Admin**Job Description Summary**


Responsible for overseeing the daily operations and administration of the IT server infrastructure. Performs a wide variety of technical duties which include, but are not limited to analysis, installation, configuration, modification, documentation, maintenance, problem diagnosis, and repair of all server technology hardware and software. Provides hardware and software technical guidance to core IT administrators and remote sites.**Job Description:**


Act as local IT support, co\-operate with corporate IT to implement standard applications and infrastructure systems in time and with high quality


Maintain IT local applications and infrastructure according to corporate IT strategy, standards, policies and best practices


Work closely with local cross function team supporting Regional/Corporate IT team on site ERP/Other major systems implementation, optimization project support/assistant


Work closely with the Plant operation and ME team to support Regional/Corporate IT on MES system implementation, optimization and supporting


IT support for local users, utilize FreshService System on incidents, problem, and change management


Work closely with Regional/Corp IT team on IT applications or systems update/optimization, be the bridge of local team and corporate IT team on new project launching


Assist finance manager on IT related budget and forecast.


Ensure IT orientation for new associates, regular IT training for end users.


All other duties as assigned

  



**Required Skills and Education**

* Bachelor’s degree major in computer science or relevant majors
* Above 8 years’ experience in Infrastructure support
* Above 2 years’ experience in ERP and MES application support
* In\-deep experience on troubleshooting and end user helpdesk supporting
* Good documentation experience (Visio, Word, etc.)
* People management skill

 **About Dauch:**


Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain\-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries \- GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.
